title: Amazon Fire TV — Install BM TV Enabler and TV Apps
excerpt: Use an Android phone or Windows PC to install BM Support TV apps; keep installation separate from staff screen sharing.
pages: Install the Android phone Enabler and log in
Prepare your devices

Have an Android phone, the TV and its normal remote ready. Put the phone and TV on the same home Wi-Fi, not mobile data or an isolated guest network. Leave both awake. BM TV Enabler runs on an Android phone or Windows PC, not on the TV, iPhone or iPad. If you do not have Android, use the Windows PC card and matching Windows guides.
Get the official phone download

Sign in at bmsupport.uk > Install Guides > Set up a device and choose your TV type, or open Remote setup on your ticket. In the Android phone card scan the QR with your phone, or tap the phone download link. On the download page press Download BM TV Enabler and save the APK to the Android phone.
Install and open

Open the APK in the phone’s Downloads or Files. If prompted, allow installation from the browser or Files app named by Android, return and press Install, then Open. You can turn that install permission off afterwards. Only use the official BM Support download; ask staff about an unexpected security warning rather than disabling phone protection.
Log in with the account PIN

Get or reveal your BM TV Enabler PIN in website Settings > BM TV Enabler PIN, or the PIN box in ticket Remote setup. Enter the six-digit PIN in the app and press Log in, then Get started. The same account PIN is used until its original 24-hour expiry and is required on every app launch. It is separate from install/sharing references and TV pairing codes. If no current PIN exists, press Get BM TV Enabler PIN; if a PIN is already allocated, press Reveal PIN and use it.
Choose and connect to the correct TV
Choose a mode and TV type

After Get started, choose Install our apps for installation only, or Screen-share support for staff help. Select Amazon Fire TV / Stick. The Enabler on your phone makes the local connection; the website cannot discover your home TV itself. If you picked the wrong TV type, change it before connecting.
Amazon Fire TV / Stick

On the TV open Settings > My Fire TV > About. Highlight the device name and press Select seven times to reveal Developer options. Go Back to My Fire TV > Developer options and turn ADB debugging ON. If Developer options already exists, use it directly. Leave the TV awake.
Find and connect

Press I’ve switched debugging on — next. Press Find my Fire TV, select the correct named TV and check its address. If it is missing, enter the address from the TV’s network settings. Press Connect to this TV. On the TV, press Allow for debugging and tick Always allow from this computer if offered. Keep the Enabler open.
If the TV is missing or unreachable

Check TV awake, correct address, same-network access and debugging ON. A discoverable TV can still have unreachable debugging. Guest Wi-Fi, VPN routing and router isolation can block connection. Discovery alone never grants access. Enter the address from the TV’s network settings if it is not listed; do not guess or expose debugging to the internet.
Install the TV apps
Wait for the install results

In Install our apps mode the Enabler checks the TV and installs the BM Support TV apps one by one. Apps already enabled in the current TV profile are skipped. Keep both devices awake until the results appear. This mode does not start screen sharing or install/check the remote-help setup for staff access.
Watch the install screen on the TV

When installing starts, the TV shows a BM Support install screen first. It names each app being installed, shows App 1 of 3 and a progress bar, and marks apps already on the TV as Already installed. Do not turn the TV off. At the end the TV shows Installation complete with a green tick and the list of apps; press OK on the TV remote to close it, or it closes by itself after 30 seconds. If it says Something went wrong, follow the steps on your phone or PC. The small BM Install Screen app only shows this screen; it has no permissions or home-screen icon.
Let the installation finish

Keep the phone or PC and TV connected and wait while the Enabler checks and installs the apps. Apps already enabled in the selected TV’s current profile are skipped. Read each result: Installed, Already on your TV, or a failure. Do not assume every app succeeded if one result reports a failure.
Use the install reference if needed

After a successful installation check, the app may show an install reference. Enter it in the reference box in your own ticket’s Remote setup when you need to confirm installation. Install and sharing references are separate. An install reference confirms installation, not screen-share readiness or permission for staff to view your TV.
Return home without resetting

Press Return to home to choose another section. You do not need Reset setup after an ordinary successful install. Installed TV apps remain installed. The Enabler remembers the selected TV and valid references; switching sections does not require a reinstall.
Saved references and troubleshooting
Understand expiry

The install reference keeps its original maximum 24-hour expiry; reopening the app does not extend it. It can expire earlier if its linked ticket/order closes. New code becomes available after the reference has been used or expired. Ending a screen share clears the sharing reference, not the separate install reference or login PIN.
If the TV cannot connect

Check same-network access, correct TV address, TV awake and debugging ON. Guest Wi-Fi or router isolation can block discovery and connection. A TV can be listed while debugging is unreachable. Approve the TV’s Allow prompt. If you refused it or permission remains stuck, ask staff before resetting authorisations or the TV.
Wireless debugging pairing

The Android phone Enabler does not have a Wireless debugging pairing-code form. If your Android/Google TV requires Pair device with pairing code, use the Windows PC Enabler: expand Android / Google TV with Wireless debugging: pair with code, enter the TV’s six-digit pairing code and pairing port, and use the main Wireless debugging screen’s IP address and connection port in TV address. Pairing and connection ports can differ. Press Pair with code and set up my TV; after successful pairing setup continues. Never type this pairing code into the ticket.
Retry safely or request help

If an app fails, read its result and error. Where no saved valid reference is being resumed, Return to home and choose Install our apps to run the install again. If the app only restores an earlier valid reference, or no install reference appeared after success, ask staff before resetting: a saved reference is not a fresh app check. Reset setup is a separate confirmed destructive action for saved TV choices/references; it does not uninstall TV apps or remove debugging authorisation. Request staff installation help from Install Guides > Help from staff during office hours, or the paid order’s help button.
safety: Only share with BM Support staff through your own support ticket. Close banking, payment, password and other private screens on the TV first. You can decline a request or end a session. Never publish your PIN or reference.

title: Amazon Fire TV — Install and Set Up BM Remote Helper
excerpt: Use BM TV Enabler to install and check BM Remote Helper and remote control before staff help.
pages: Prepare the Enabler for remote help
Use the correct apps

BM TV Enabler runs on your Android phone or Windows PC. BM Remote Helper and BM Remote Control run on the TV. You do not need the Helper installed beforehand: Screen-share support installs missing remote-help apps and checks them. Install our apps is the separate mode for the viewing/store apps.
Download and log in

Use Install Guides > Set up a device or your ticket’s Remote setup to download the official Android phone or Windows Enabler. Follow the matching Enabler installation guide. Reveal your six-digit BM TV Enabler PIN in Settings or ticket Remote setup; log in and press Get started. iPhone/iPad cannot run the Enabler; use a Windows PC instead. If no current PIN exists, press Get BM TV Enabler PIN; if a PIN is already allocated, press Reveal PIN and use it.
Choose Screen-share support

Select Screen-share support, then the correct TV type. Keep the phone/PC on the same home network as the TV. Enable the TV’s debugging setting and press I’ve switched debugging on — next. The following page gives the device-specific steps.
Do not sideload Helper with Downloader

Let BM TV Enabler install the Helper and control app using its secured installer. Installing them through Downloader can trigger restricted Accessibility settings on newer Android TVs. Do not use old Helper download/code-entry instructions or uninstall a working app during an active share.
Choose and connect to the correct TV
Choose a mode and TV type

After Get started, choose Install our apps for installation only, or Screen-share support for staff help. Select Amazon Fire TV / Stick. The Enabler on your phone or Windows PC makes the local connection; the website cannot discover your home TV itself. If you picked the wrong TV type, change it before connecting.
Amazon Fire TV / Stick

On the TV open Settings > My Fire TV > About. Highlight the device name and press Select seven times to reveal Developer options. Go Back to My Fire TV > Developer options and turn ADB debugging ON. If Developer options already exists, use it directly. Leave the TV awake.
Find and connect

Press I’ve switched debugging on — next. Press Find my Fire TV, select the correct named TV and check its address. If it is missing, enter the address from the TV’s network settings. Press Connect to this TV. On the TV, press Allow for debugging and tick Always allow from this computer if offered. Keep the Enabler open.
If the TV is missing or unreachable

Check TV awake, correct address, same-network access and debugging ON. A discoverable TV can still have unreachable debugging. Guest Wi-Fi, VPN routing and router isolation can block connection. Discovery alone never grants access. Enter the address from the TV’s network settings if it is not listed; do not guess or expose debugging to the internet.
Install, enable control and check
Allow the Enabler connection

On the TV approve Allow debugging/Allow USB debugging and tick Always allow from this computer if offered. Keep the Enabler open. Debugging authorises this phone/PC to set up the TV; it is not consent for staff to see your picture.
Let the app complete setup

The Enabler checks what is installed, installs BM Remote Helper and BM Remote Control where needed, enables remote control and runs a fresh readiness check. Read and resolve any error before continuing. On newer Fire OS, the TV cannot enable its own control through self-ADB; the external phone/PC Enabler performs this setup.
If Accessibility needs attention

The Enabler should report a passing control/Accessibility check after configuring the Fire TV. If it does not, check debugging approval and read the displayed error. Ask staff rather than repeatedly reinstalling or resetting the TV. Fire TV and Android/Google TV permission menus differ.
Keep Helper in front and get a sharing reference

When BM Remote Helper opens, leave it in front so the TV can show its sharing permission prompt. Wait for the Enabler’s fresh successful TV check, then press Get my confirmation code if no sharing reference is shown. Enter that Enabler reference on your ticket, not the Helper’s six-digit code. Use the matching Use Remote Help guide next. Watch the TV: if Helper asks for Start sharing or recording/casting approval, use the TV remote to approve the help you requested. The Enabler cannot approve sharing consent for you. The reference has six letters/numbers displayed in two groups of three, separated by a hyphen; it is not a six-digit PIN.
Finish safely and troubleshoot
Understand the different codes

The six-digit account PIN logs in to Enabler. Its install reference confirms app installation only. Its sharing reference links a checked TV to one ticket/order. Android Wireless debugging may also have a separate six-digit pairing code. Never type the Helper’s TV code on the website for this Enabler flow; the Enabler transfers it automatically.
Do not skip sharing consent

Control/Accessibility allows operation, but each share still needs the TV’s requested Allow and recording/casting approval. Decline unexpected requests. A setup check or reference does not give staff permanent access.
If no prompt or no picture appears

Keep Helper in front, Enabler open and TV awake. Confirm the network and selected TV. Ask staff to join the exact ticket. Use the website’s Send to BM TV Enabler or Ask my TV again if a fresh connection is requested. Do not press Home before the permission prompt; staff controls can move the TV once the picture connection is ready.
Later sessions need a fresh reference

Ending a screen share expires its sharing reference immediately. The website resets; when the Enabler receives expiry it clears that sharing reference and offers New code. Do a fresh TV check and enter the new reference for the next share. Install reference, login PIN, installed TV apps and ordinary saved debugging authorisation remain separate.
safety: Only share with BM Support staff through your own support ticket. Close banking, payment, password and other private screens on the TV first. You can decline a request or end a session. Never publish your PIN or reference.

title: Amazon Fire TV — Use Remote Help
excerpt: Use the Enabler sharing reference on your ticket, approve your TV and request a fresh reference after every ended share.
pages: Prepare your ticket and Enabler
Check the prerequisites

Have your TV and normal remote, internet access and an Android phone or Windows 10/11 64-bit PC on the same home network. Keep all devices awake. For iPhone/iPad users, the Windows PC Enabler is the alternative. Complete the matching Enabler installation guide first; do not install Enabler on the TV.
Raise installation help in the right place

For installation assistance choose Install Guides > Set up a device > Help from staff during office hours. A paid order’s remote installation help button creates a support ticket during office hours too. Open that ticket and its Remote setup; customer orders do not have remote setup tabs.
Log in and choose Screen-share support

Reveal your current account BM TV Enabler PIN in Settings or ticket Remote setup. Enter it in the phone/Windows app, press Log in, Get started, then Screen-share support. Each launch asks for the PIN. Return to home changes sections without clearing valid references. If no current PIN exists, press Get BM TV Enabler PIN; if a PIN is already allocated, press Reveal PIN and use it.
Protect private information

Close password, bank, payment and other private TV screens before sharing. Staff may see anything on the TV during the session. Only approve BM Support help you requested in your own ticket. Do not post PINs, references or TV codes publicly.
Choose and connect to the correct TV
Choose a mode and TV type

After Get started, choose Install our apps for installation only, or Screen-share support for staff help. Select Amazon Fire TV / Stick. The Enabler on your phone or PC makes the local connection; the website cannot discover your home TV itself. If you picked the wrong TV type, change it before connecting.
Amazon Fire TV / Stick

On the TV open Settings > My Fire TV > About. Highlight the device name and press Select seven times to reveal Developer options. Go Back to My Fire TV > Developer options and turn ADB debugging ON. If Developer options already exists, use it directly. Leave the TV awake.
Find and connect

Press I’ve switched debugging on — next. Press Find my Fire TV, select the correct named TV and check its address. If it is missing, enter the address from the TV’s network settings. Press Connect to this TV. On the TV, press Allow for debugging and tick Always allow from this computer if offered. Keep the Enabler open.
If the TV is missing or unreachable

Check TV awake, correct address, same-network access and debugging ON. A discoverable TV can still have unreachable debugging. Guest Wi-Fi, VPN routing and router isolation can block connection. Discovery alone never grants access. Enter the address from the TV’s network settings if it is not listed; do not guess or expose debugging to the internet.
Check the TV and enter the reference
Approve debugging and wait

Select the correct TV, press Connect to this TV and approve the TV’s Allow debugging prompt, ticking Always allow if offered. Enabler checks, installs missing remote-help apps and enables control. Wait for a passing fresh TV check. Keep Helper in front when it opens.
Get the Enabler sharing reference

Press Get my confirmation code if no reference is displayed after setup. Use the sharing reference shown by your phone/Windows Enabler, not the account PIN, install reference, Wireless debugging pairing code or Helper’s six-digit TV code. The Helper connection is transferred automatically. Watch the TV: if Helper asks for Start sharing or recording/casting approval, use the TV remote to approve the help you requested. The Enabler cannot approve sharing consent for you. The reference has six letters/numbers displayed in two groups of three, separated by a hyphen; it is not a six-digit PIN.
Enter it on the ticket

In ticket Remote setup, type the reference in its reference box and confirm. If another ticket/order used it, get New code in the Enabler. If the website shows an older/different reference, press Change reference number and enter the app’s current one. A valid reference does not move another ticket’s session. Enter the six-character reference in Type the code from BM TV Enabler, then press Confirm.
Read the three status ticks

App logged in means the Enabler login is recognised, not that staff can see the TV. TV connected means the TV check is recognised. Ready to share follows acceptance of the sharing reference and readiness checks. If a tick is delayed, keep the Enabler open and check the reference belongs to this ticket; permission still has to be approved on the TV.
Link the reference, share and finish
Enter the Enabler reference

Type the sharing reference shown by BM TV Enabler into your own ticket’s Remote setup reference box and confirm it. Each reference belongs to one ticket/order while valid. If another ticket/order already used it, get New code in the Enabler. If your PC shows a different reference from the website, use Change reference number and enter the current one. Enter the six-character reference in Type the code from BM TV Enabler, then press Confirm.
Connect and approve

If the website first needs a fresh TV connection, keep BM TV Enabler open on the same network and press Send to BM TV Enabler or Ask my TV again. When it says Waiting for you to press Allow on your TV, approve the requested TV prompt and wait for the page to advance. When Connect my screen appears, press it. Watch Helper on the TV and approve any requested Allow, Start sharing and system recording/casting prompt using the TV remote. Enabler does not accept these for you. A reference or green readiness tick is not sharing consent; do not repeatedly press Connect while waiting.
Work with staff

Your ticket’s Screen share opens when connected. Ask staff to confirm they can see the TV. Keep the PC Enabler open, the TV awake and the Helper running while the connection is being established. Use the ticket conversation to speak with staff. Tell staff before opening private screens; enabled remote control allows them to operate the TV during the session.
End and request a fresh reference

End the session from the sharing controls or ask staff to end it. Once the linked screen share ends, its sharing reference expires and the website setup clears. The Enabler clears the expired reference when it receives the server update; press New code and complete a fresh TV check before sharing again. Closure of the ticket/order also expires it; otherwise its maximum lifetime is 24 hours. Install reference and login PIN are unaffected.
Reconnect and solve problems
Reopen or switch sections

Every app launch requires the current account PIN. After login, valid saved references can be resumed without extending expiry. Return to home switches between Install our apps and Screen-share support while retaining TV details and each section’s valid reference. A network error alone does not erase a reference.
Restart website setup

Restart setup clears the ticket’s setup and releases its still-valid reference so you can type the reference the Enabler currently shows again. It does not make an expired sharing reference valid. After a share ends, ask for New code in the Enabler. Reset setup inside the app is a separate confirmed action which clears local TV details and both references; the next code takes over.
No picture or no permission box

Keep BM Remote Helper in front on the TV and approve the requested prompts. Check the PC and TV still share the same network. Ask staff to confirm they joined this ticket. If no picture appears, tell staff before ending and retrying with a fresh reference. Do not factory-reset or reinstall the TV as your first troubleshooting step.
Pairing or control problems

If Android/Google TV requires Wireless debugging code pairing, use the Windows PC Enabler: its pairing form accepts the TV’s six-digit pairing code and pairing port, while TV address uses the main Wireless debugging connection IP:port. The Android phone app has no pairing-code form. If control/Accessibility is unavailable, report the Enabler’s error to staff; do not disable TV security.
safety: Only share with BM Support staff through your own support ticket. Close banking, payment, password and other private screens on the TV first. You can decline a request or end a session. Never publish your PIN or reference.

Use the ticket conversation to speak with staff. Tell staff before opening private screens; enabled remote control allows them to operate the TV during the session.
End and request a fresh reference

End the session from the sharing controls or ask staff to end it. Once the linked screen share ends, its sharing reference expires and the website setup clears. The Enabler clears the expired reference when it receives the server update; press New code and complete a fresh TV check before sharing again. Closure of the ticket/order also expires it; otherwise its maximum lifetime is 24 hours. Install reference and login PIN are unaffected.
Reconnect and solve problems
Reopen or switch sections

Every app launch requires the current account PIN. After login, valid saved references can be resumed without extending expiry. Return to home switches between Install our apps and Screen-share support while retaining TV details and each section’s valid reference. A network error alone does not erase a reference.
Restart website setup

Restart setup clears the ticket’s setup and releases its still-valid reference so you can type the reference the Enabler currently shows again. It does not make an expired sharing reference valid. After a share ends, ask for New code in the Enabler. Reset setup inside the app is a separate confirmed action which clears local TV details and both references; the next code takes over.
No picture or no permission box

Keep BM Remote Helper in front on the TV and approve the requested prompts. Check the PC and TV still share the same network. Ask staff to confirm they joined this ticket. If no picture appears, tell staff before ending and retrying with a fresh reference. Do not factory-reset or reinstall the TV as your first troubleshooting step.
Pairing or control problems

If Android/Google TV requires Wireless debugging code pairing, use the Windows PC Enabler: its pairing form accepts the TV’s six-digit pairing code and pairing port, while TV address uses the main Wireless debugging connection IP:port. The Android phone app has no pairing-code form. If control/Accessibility is unavailable, report the Enabler’s error to staff; do not disable TV security.

title: Windows PC — Install BM TV Enabler and TV Apps
platform: Windows PC · Amazon Fire TV / Android / Google TV
excerpt: Install the Windows Enabler, sign in with your PIN and put BM Support apps on your TV.
pages: Install Windows Enabler and log in
Check what you need

Use a Windows 10 or 11, 64-bit PC and an Amazon Fire TV/Stick or Android/Google TV. The PC and TV must be on the same home network, not isolated guest Wi-Fi. Keep both awake; disconnect a VPN if it prevents local connections. BM TV Enabler runs on the PC, not on the TV, iPhone or iPad.
Download from BM Support

Sign in at bmsupport.uk, open Install Guides > Set up a device and choose your TV type. In the Windows PC card, download BM TV Enabler. The same Windows download is also shown in ticket Remote setup. Use the official download button for the latest installer.
Install and open

Open the downloaded BM-TV-Enabler-Setup installer and follow its installation prompts. The Windows installer is unsigned, so Windows may show a publisher warning. Check that it came from BM Support. If your PC blocks it or you are unsure, ask staff; do not disable antivirus or security protection.
Enter your account PIN

Open Settings > BM TV Enabler PIN on the website, or reveal the PIN in ticket Remote setup. Enter the six-digit PIN in BM TV Enabler, press Log in, then Get started. The app asks for the PIN on every launch; use the current PIN, which changes after 24 hours. This login PIN is not the later Enabler reference or a TV pairing code. If no current PIN exists, press Get BM TV Enabler PIN; if a PIN is already allocated, press Reveal PIN and use it.
Choose Install our apps

After Get started choose Install our apps, then select Amazon Fire TV / Stick or Android / Google TV. The next page connects to that TV. For staff help choose Screen-share support instead and use the separate usage guide.
Prepare debugging and select the TV
Choose your TV type

Select Amazon Fire TV / Stick or Android / Google TV. Follow only the instructions for the TV you are using. The website cannot discover or connect to your home TV itself: BM TV Enabler does this from your PC.
Amazon Fire TV / Stick

On the TV open Settings > My Fire TV > About. Highlight the device name and press Select seven times to reveal Developer options. Go Back to My Fire TV > Developer options and turn ADB debugging ON. If Developer options already exists, use it directly. Leave the TV awake.
Android / Google TV

On the TV open Settings > System > About (some TVs use Device Preferences > About). Highlight Android TV OS build and press Select seven times. Return to System > Developer options and enable Network debugging, or Wireless debugging where offered. Menu names vary by TV. Do not expose debugging ports to the internet.
Find and connect

Press I’ve switched debugging on — next. Choose Find my Fire TV or Find my Android TV, select the correct named TV and check its address. If it is missing, enter the address from the TV’s network settings. Press Connect to this TV. On the TV, press Allow for debugging and tick Always allow from this computer if offered. Keep the Enabler open.
Install the TV apps
Installation mode does not start a share

Install our apps installs the BM Support TV viewing/store apps. Screen-share support is the separate mode which installs/checks Helper and control for staff help. Installation success alone does not mean staff can see or control your screen.
Watch the install screen on the TV

When installing starts, the TV shows a BM Support install screen first. It names each app being installed, shows App 1 of 3 and a progress bar, and marks apps already on the TV as Already installed. Do not turn the TV off. At the end the TV shows Installation complete with a green tick and the list of apps; press OK on the TV remote to close it, or it closes by itself after 30 seconds. If it says Something went wrong, follow the steps on your phone or PC. The small BM Install Screen app only shows this screen; it has no permissions or home-screen icon.
Let the installation finish

Keep the PC and TV connected and wait while the Enabler checks and installs the apps. Apps already enabled in the selected TV’s current profile are skipped. Read each result: Installed, Already on your TV, or a failure. Do not assume every app succeeded if one result reports a failure.
Use the install reference if needed

After a successful installation check, the app may show an install reference. Enter it in the reference box in your own ticket’s Remote setup when you need to confirm installation. Install and sharing references are separate. An install reference confirms installation, not screen-share readiness or permission for staff to view your TV.
Return home without resetting

Press Return to home to choose another section. You do not need Reset setup after an ordinary successful install. Installed TV apps remain installed. The Enabler remembers the selected TV and valid references; switching sections does not require a reinstall.
Saved references and troubleshooting
Understand expiry

The install reference keeps its original maximum 24-hour expiry; reopening the app does not extend it. It can expire earlier if its linked ticket/order closes. New code becomes available after the reference has been used or expired. Ending a screen share clears the sharing reference, not the separate install reference or login PIN.
If the TV cannot connect

Check same-network access, correct TV address, TV awake and debugging ON. Guest Wi-Fi or router isolation can block discovery and connection. A TV can be listed while debugging is unreachable. Approve the TV’s Allow prompt. If you refused it or permission remains stuck, ask staff before resetting authorisations or the TV.
Wireless debugging pairing

If Android/Google TV requires pairing, expand Android / Google TV with Wireless debugging: pair with code. On the TV choose Wireless debugging > Pair device with pairing code. Enter that six-digit code and its pairing port in the app. Use the IP address and connection port from the main Wireless debugging screen for TV address; the two ports can differ. Press Pair with code and set up my TV; the Enabler pairs and continues setup automatically on success.
Retry safely or request help

If an app fails, read its result and error. Where no saved valid reference is being resumed, Return to home and choose Install our apps to run the install again. If the app only restores an earlier valid reference, or no install reference appeared after success, ask staff before resetting: a saved reference is not a fresh app check. Reset setup is a separate confirmed destructive action for saved TV choices/references; it does not uninstall TV apps or remove debugging authorisation. Request staff installation help from Install Guides > Help from staff during office hours, or the paid order’s help button.
safety: Only share with BM Support staff through your own support ticket. Close banking, payment, password and other private screens on the TV first. You can decline a request or end a session. Never publish your PIN or reference.
